name: Felsőpáhok (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Felsőpáhok: a green shield with a bunch of grapes, crossed tools and a yellow field, inscribed FELSŐPÁHOK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
